dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Tom. I've just moved to Bangkok from England.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ˈtɑːm. aɪv dʒʌst ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk frəm ˈɪŋɡlənd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Welcome! I'm Nam. Bangkok is my hometown.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛlkəm! aɪm ˈnɑːm. ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So you've lived here for a long time.
dialogue.reading: soʊ juːv ˈlɪvd ˈhɪr fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, for twenty years. I grew up in Bang Rak, an old neighborhood near the river. My family still lives there.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, fər ˈtwɛnti ˈjɪrz. aɪ ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɪn ˈbɑːŋ ˈrɑːk, ən ˈoʊld ˈneɪbərhʊd ˈnɪr ðə ˈrɪvər. maɪ ˈfæməli ˈstɪl ˈlɪvz ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's busy, but the community is very friendly. My parents have lived in the same house since 2005.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈbɪzi, bʌt ðə kəˈmjuːnəti ɪz ˈvɛri ˈfrɛndli. maɪ ˈpɛrənts hæv ˈlɪvd ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈhaʊs sɪns ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈfaɪv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nice! I live in a suburb. I've been there since Monday. It's quiet, but it's far from downtown.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! aɪ ˈlɪv ɪn ə ˈsʌbɜːrb. aɪv bɪn ˈðɛr sɪns ˈmʌndeɪ. ɪts ˈkwaɪət, bʌt ɪts ˈfɑːr frəm ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then come downtown on the weekend. The food is great!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈkʌm ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd. ðə ˈfuːd ɪz ˈɡreɪt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Can I visit your neighborhood someday?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈvɪzɪt jʊr ˈneɪbərhʊd ˈsʌmdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure! Let's go together one day.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr! ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ təˈɡɛðər ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.
